column1: # ADR-068 Group 3b (entry points): the rows the integrator adds to lowering-accepted-differences.tsv at the freeze, in its format.
# Two further cases are new, the saved diverge-068-ledger-*.diffcase, and have no committed reference row yet (REFERENCE-DRIFT,
# "no committed row"): the freeze writes their reference rows, and each is a Semantic fix of the same kind as below.

column3: Semantic fix (D6, ledger fromPlutusData): the reference reads a ledger type's fromPlutusData as an identity, which passes Data the JVM's decoder refuses and leaves a hash as Data where bytes are read; JAVAC checks the Data for exactly the type's shape, the strict boundary's check, with one dispatcher per program, and decodes what the type holds, so the script fails wherever the JVM throws. Data with a part the JVM's decoder ignores fails too: a Policy rejection (D13), a ledger type decodes only the exact shape on-chain. The bytes and budgets grow by the check. Evidence: diverge-068-ledger-from-data-refused, diverge-068-ledger-hash-from-data, JavacLedgerFromDataTest, Adr068LedgerFromDataPropertyTest, Adr068LedgerFromDataMutationTest
